input: Find churches that run weekly summer day camps (not just Vacation Bible School) for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania, Polk, Haywood and Jackson counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon, Waynesville, Sylva). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Sylva
candidates.note: First Explorers summer day camp ran across multiple weeks in 2026, with chapel, crafts, swimming and field trips.

candidates.name: Cullowhee United Methodist Church
candidates.note: 2025 summer camps served ages 2–5 and completed K–5 across eight weeks; also runs Whee Read summer literacy programming.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Hendersonville
candidates.note: Listed FBC Summer Kids for 2026, plus July 6–10 morning choir camp for completed grades 1–5 and preschool Splash Camp.
